description: This Java class handles the command for deleting a client collateral product within the collateral management module of the Apache Fineract project. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Spring Service, and is triggered by the command type 'DELETE' on 'CLIENT_COLLATERAL_PRODUCT'. The core logic delegates the delete operation to the ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformService.

classes.name: DeleteClientCollateralProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that processes commands to delete a client collateral product. Implements NewCommandSourceHandler and overrides processCommand to delegate deletion to the service layer.

methods.name: DeleteClientCollateralProductCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects ClientCollateralManagementWritePlatformService via constructor injection.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the delete command by calling the deleteClientCollateralProduct method of the injected service, passing the entityId from the JSON command.
